notes.title: Planetiles - Content Update #2 is now available!
notes.notes:
Our fellow space settlers 👋 

August is almost finished and we're excited to share that Planetiles content update no 2 is now available for free as a part of the roadmap! We're adding new disruptive technologies, increasing level cap and squashing some remaining UI space bugs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534512/0a00ddcc3c501eb3988d975d74a2bb6ccc709ee6.png[/img]

Full update notes:
[list]
[*] Added 2nd & 3rd Disruptive Technologies - 'Cosmic Rage' and 'Fully Stacked'
     [u]Cosmic Rage[/u]: Cataclysms are bigger and occur every 350, players get chunks only when 
     cataclysms are reached
     [u]Fully Stacked[/u]: Players start with 100 chunks but do not receive chunks every 100 points
[*] Added 2 new technologies (X-Shape and Points Shifter)
     [u]X-Shape[/u]: Added cross-like chunk shapes
     [u]Points Shifter[/u]: First mission earns 150%, all other missions earn 50%
[*] Increased player level cap to 28 allowing to unlock new technologies
[*] Fixed minor UI issues 
[*] Fixed leaderboards scaling on lower resolutions
[/list]
These tech additions fulfill Planetiles console interface and now we're back to the drawing board with the last, suprise content drop nexth month. Stay tuned as we're getting closer to finalise our stellar puzzle journey!

notes.title: Roadmap: Disruptive Technology Update is now available!
notes.notes:
Our fellow Space Settlers!

We're excited to release first part of a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2447030/view/4199120329632213718?l=english]recently announced Planetiles roadmap[/url] - the[b] Disruptive Tech [/b]update. We're celebrating by adding a cool [b]25% discount until June 24th[/b]!

Let's dive deeper into each new addition and see how it affects gameplay 👇

[h3]New Disruptive Technology - Pressure Dissolver[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534512/ada8dbc78b7e0edc25ea03869f2efe55a1ae797a.png[/img]

Disruptive Tech is a new type of technology that takes over all 3 basic technology slots. In this roadmap update, we're introducing first type of such tech - the [b]Pressure Dissolver[/b]. This relaxed, laid-back tech disables all cataclysms, basic technologies and structures, giving players 5 chunk rerolls every 500 points. It is the first type of disruptive tech that we're introducing so stay tuned for more in the upcoming roadmap updates.

[h3]Increased Level Cap[/h3]
We increased the level cap from 21 to 24. Players that already maxed out the XP and reached level 21 will need to put in some additional effort to unlock new missions and most importantly - new Disruptive Technology.

[h3]New missions[/h3]
We've added 2 new mission types to Planetiles. Players need to unlock them first by achieving certain xp levels: first mission (small planet) is unlocked by reaching level 22 and second (medium planet) - on level 24. Once unlocked, these new missions will appear on any playthrough.

[h3]Other quality of life improvements[/h3]
[b]Find my Land[/b] - In the Infinite Mode, if player hovers far away from already built islands and cant find the way back, simply clicking (LMB or A/X on a gamepad) will automatically transport player to the last built structure. 

[b]Improved Menu/UI navigation[/b] - We added a number of UI and menu changes with options to hide informational text during tutorials, highlighting structeres once hovered on and many other smaller improvements to make gameplay easier to understand and follow tracks of missions and structural perks. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534512/9e44196c4df1a8d7b67fcf29f7978d3830003677.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534512/bea40bd39550d4f2444f10c93659a58ba6a5a3c5.jpg[/img]


Full update notes:
[list]
[*] Added 1st Disruptive Technology - Pressure Dissolver
[*] Added 2 new missions unlocked by reaching certain player levels
[*] Increased player level cap to 24
[*] Music is now resumed correctly after restarting the level
[*] Option to hide the informational text bar during the tutorial
[*] Fixed Climate Warming cataclysm visual effects
[*] Structures are now highlighted when player hovers over them
[*] Fixed rare situations where gaps are surrounded by ice on icy mission
[*] Added "Find my Land" feature when navigating away on infinite planet
[*] Improved menu navigation hiding objects below current UI layer
[*] Added water tile preview to Sandbox mode
[*] Fixed NPCs like rabbits or harvesters not disappearing after tile removal
[*] Fixed rare performance issues on Linux and improved performance overall on all platforms
[/list]

[h3]Get Planetiles Soundtrack[/h3]
Planetiles soundtrack is also getting a cool 50% off until June 24th so you can now get it for just $0.49!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2934430/Planetiles_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Post launch update
notes.notes:
Hello Space Settlers 👨‍🚀

First of all - [b]we'd like to thank everyone[/b] for supporting us during Planetiles journey - your feedback, kind words, all the conversations we had during Gamescom and PAX events really meant a lot to us! 🙏

While we're already thinking about next games, Planetiles project is far from over and we'd like to give you a glimpse of what's coming to our cozy space citybuilder. Firstly, we addressed the issues reported by our community - related to ultrawide monitors settings access and some minor updates of UI on handheld devices, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2447030/view/4185606994275997313?l=english]all now hotfixed[/url].

[h3]Reviews Roundup[/h3]

We had couple really cool media outlets doing reviews and wanted to share some of the quotes and scores below:
[list]
[*] [b]Gamespew[/b] - 8/10 - “It may be tricky, but playing Planetiles is an utter joy, even if you do keep failing. It’s the sort of game you can play in short, 15 minute bursts — or you can end up losing hours to it at a time”
[url=https://www.gamespew.com/2024/04/planetiles-review/]https://www.gamespew.com/2024/04/planetiles-review/[/url]

[*] [b]Try Hard Guides[/b] - 8/10 - “Planetiles offers a cosmic twist on classic puzzle formulas, inviting players to embark on a challenging journey of terraforming and colonization. The game gradually reveals its charms, beckoning players to explore its celestial landscapes one block at a time”
[url=https://tryhardguides.com/planetiles-review-earthbuilding/]https://tryhardguides.com/planetiles-review-earthbuilding/[/url]

[*] [b]Rogueliker [/b]"Planetiles is a lovely, moderately priced roguish puzzle game, and if you like the sound of it based on the words above, I suggest you take this one out for a spin."
[url=https://rogueliker.com/planetiles-review/]https://rogueliker.com/planetiles-review/[/url]

[*] [b]Voletic[/b] - 4/5 - "It’s really just a nice game to relax too. There’s a good amount of variety, and replayability to be found."
[url=https://www.voletic.com/reviews/planetiles-review-pc/]https://www.voletic.com/reviews/planetiles-review-pc/[/url]

[*] [b]Quest Daily [/b]- 75/100 - "Planetiles is a delightful blend of creativity, strategy, and relaxation. It gives me the wonderful vibes of Free Live’s Tera Nil, crossed with classic Tetris."
[url=https://questdaily.com.au/review/review-planetiles-tetris-had-a-spherical-galactic-baby-pc/]https://questdaily.com.au/review/review-planetiles-tetris-had-a-spherical-galactic-baby-pc/[/url]
[/list]
For more incoming reviews, feel free to visit [url=https://opencritic.com/game/16533/planetiles]Planetiles on Opencritic[/url].

[h3]What's Next for Planetiles?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534512/4be50c279f7b22a6b7d0566e181d54ed551f0976.jpg[/img]

With Planetiles release now behind us, we're now focused on improving Planetiles further and have couple things held in a locker, that we're looking to reveal in the upcoming weeks:

1. [b]Soundtrack[/b] - already in the oven, should have it ready & out on Steam by [b]next week[/b]! 

2. [b]Roadmap[/b] - we're working on introducing a road map with all the upcoming features and content coming to Planetiles. Doing our best to present it to our community by the [b]end of April[/b].

3. [b]Patches & gameplay improvements[/b] - these updates don't have a time frame, we plan to keep them coming and if any issues pop up, we'll make sure to address them straight away.

4. [b]Suprise collabos and bundles[/b] - while we have to stay quiet about it, best we can share is expect the unexpected! 

[h3]Let's talk Planetiles![/h3]

We're always happy to see new faces joining our Discord, so feel invited to jump in via link below and let's celebrate the launch together 👇
